title: Mobile Application Developer
description:
JD App Developer
  
Location: Howrah, West Bengal (On-site)
  
Company: Matri – A Shark Tank India Featured Brand in Female Wellness ( Silifarm Technologies Private Limited )
  
Company website – www.mymatri.com
  
Instagram - @matriofficial
  
  
Matri is on a mission to revolutionize female wellness. Featured on Shark Tank India, we are building a brand that breaks taboos and brings comfort to women across the country with our innovative solution Matri - A Menstrual Pain reliever device. We're building a mobile application and looking for a Flutter developer who writes clean, maintainable code and is eager to grow with a small, fast-moving team.
  
  
Flutter Developer
  
Experience: Freshers or 1–2 years experience preferred
  
Role & Responsibilities Development and support of Matri Application ( Android / IOS ) and work on backend API Should work with:
  
- Riverpod, Clean Architecture, and feature-first project structure
  
- Local-first storage using SQLite (Drift) and offline data synchronization
  
- BLE device integration, secure storage, and push notifications
  
- Is interested in upskilling in backend development and learning Django and Python
  
- Cares about code quality and pays attention to detail
  
- Communicates honestly and takes ownership of their work
  
  
Nice to have: A published app, open-source contributions, or a GitHub portfolio.
  
  
Qualification – B.Tech ( CSE /IT ) preferred Knowledge in - Dart and Flutter - widgets, state management, and responsive UI
  
- REST API integration and asynchronous programming
  
- Git and basic debugging
  
  
What We Offer
  
•Opportunity to be part of the core team of a Shark Tank India–featured startup
  
•Creative freedom to bring fresh ideas
  
•Career growth as the company expands nationwide
  
•We are offering a salary in the range of ₹3.6–5.4 LPA (Negotiable) , based on experience and skills.
